name: What is the advantage of using a general contractor over hiring individual trade specialists for storm repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of using a general contractor over hiring individual trade specialists for storm repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor gives you a single point of contact who manages every phase of rebuilding. Water and storm intrusion rarely affects just one surface; it frequently damages drywall, framing, trim carpentry, and electrical lines simultaneously. Rather than coordinating separate drywallers, finish carpenters, painters, and electricians, an experienced general contractor manages the entire workflow. This approach prevents scheduling delays between drying and rebuilding, ensures consistent finish quality, and helps align your restoration project from initial framing adjustments through final paint coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor coordinates framing, drywall, carpentry, and electrical trades under one point of contact, preventing delays and mismatched finishes.
